title: Conditional κ = 7.45287034630032e-4: PR280's early restoration of 440 cleanup helpers on the gen5 word, after #291's stages
body:
Conditional κ = `46580439664377/(625·10^14)` = **7.45287034630032e-4**, +5.58 × 10⁻⁷ (+0.075 %) over [#291](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/291) (7.44728650221677e-4), +0.077 % over [#290](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/290), +0.157 % over [#287](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/287), +0.337 % over [#285](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/285)'s gen5 word. The bit side binds.

One self-contained package, `research/five-stage-gen5-restore/` (#291's package with one added stage), with its own workflow. No existing file is changed.

**Full replay: PASS** on the committed package (`8d82520`): all stages (virtual, raw, bit with descent, target, kernel, second descent and restoration; scalar, primes, banks, complex, math, finite), package integrity unchanged (144 files, manifest `efcf9097…`), `PASS_IMMUTABLE_GEN5_KERNEL_ENTRIES_FIVE_STAGE_BANKED_CONSTRUCTION`, κ `46580439664377/62500000000000000`, ~6 minutes.

**Note (posted after #295 appeared):** [#295](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/295) (chafreaky) independently applies the same 440 restorations with the same completion `P_σ + I − P_E` and (σ, E) charts, plus 8 terminal sinks and #233's complex supplier, and stands above this PR (7.45514e-4 vs 7.45287e-4). This PR remains as the restoration stage composed with #291's second descent (its restoration-only rung, 7.45273e-4 on #290's word, matches #295's restoration-only figure); the two accountings agree.

## Change

**PR280's early restoration of cleanup helpers, on gen5.** [#280](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/280) (utcorvusvolat-dotcom) restored 440 gen4 helpers early; the gen5 lineage (#285 → #287 → #290 → #291) branched from #276 and never had it. The same census on the gen5 word after the descent, target-square, kernel and second-descent stages finds the same shape: at the first `cleanup_gate` ADD (record 601,802; no COPY/ERASE follows), **440 helpers `a`** have exactly one later scalar incidence, a write `a -= c·b` with a donor `b` unwritten in between, both at 22-dimensional frames whose rational span `E` is a nondegenerate 23-dimensional frame; all helpers and donors are distinct and disjoint. The write commutes over the integers with every crossed gate (none reads `a`, writes `a` or writes `b`), so `restore_transform.py` moves it to the cut: `a` and `b` advance to `E`, the unchanged ADD runs there and `a` retires at `E` instead of climbing to the full frame; `b` continues as before. Two rank-2 climbs per pair become three rank-1 climbs: local histogram delta {1: +1320, 2: −880}, local rank mass −440, priced literal stock 1,244,515 → 1,243,415. The transform checks the commutation conditions, the unchanged scalar-event multiset (byte-identical prefix, suffix minus the 440 writes), the exact integer source spans of both operands inside `E`, nesting, data endpoints, COPY lifetimes, nondegenerate endpoint bases and both reflected ledgers; `scalar_check` replays all 19,406 columns forward and inverse on the emitted word (row bounds unchanged: 67,127 / 2,360,408).

**Admission of helpers that retire below the full frame** (`RESTORE-PROOF.md`). A restored helper with entrance σ (dim 20) and endpoint `E` (dim 23) changes content only in the residual `D_(E−σ)` of rank 3 (#280's accounting); its single direction `E^⊥` is never touched (all of its frames nest inside `E`) and is completed together with σ:
* `global_lowering.Lowerer` reads every helper endpoint from the actual records, requires it to be declared by the physical census, and emits completions of rank 5·(dim σ + 24 − dim E) = 105; the one-replica identity `LIVE·120 − rank mass = 4400` is unchanged (five-stage rank mass 2,746,720);
* `geometry527` checks on an actual restored helper that `P_σ + I − P_E` and `P_E − P_σ` are exact commuting projectors over the five windows with traces 105 and 15, product zero, sum the identity;
* `bank_check.census` assigns families by the actual residual width dim E − dim σ (the 440 helpers become width-3 families beside gen5's 354 rank-21 entrances) and builds 440 new exact (σ, E) charts — residual rows = integer basis of the G-orthogonal complement of σ inside `E`, idle row = cleared annihilator of `E`, source rows = basis of σ — inverted exactly with their factor programs replayed (985 charts); `bank_template` retiles 3,484 (4³⁰) and 1,191 (3⁴⁰) banks per stage (821,015 banks; all 4,765,800 assignments enumerated; selector calls 932,936,528,400 < 2⁴⁰);
* `math_check`/`finite_check` remove the completions (entrance + idle) from the priced histogram: priced calls 477,380, rank mass 2,482,430, `120·stock − literal mass = 264,000`.

Every changed count is a recomputed pinned value in `expected/kernel-pins.json` (`restored_helpers`, `restore_five_stage_calls`, `completion_rank_histogram`, `restored_endpoint_dimension_histogram`, `bank_families`, `literal_stock`, `banks_total`, `charts`, `priced_five_stage_calls`, `scalar_event_sha256`, `kappa`, …); none dropped. Then every stage of #291's verifier runs fresh — virtual, raw, bit (descent, target, kernel, second descent, restoration), scalar, primes, banks, complex, math, finite — with its omitted-stage negative controls.

| one invocation, m = 120 | #290 | #291 | this package |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| five-stage calls | 477,859 | 478,184 | **480,384** |
| priced calls / rank mass | 475,180 / 2,484,630 | 475,180 / 2,484,630 | **477,380 / 2,482,430** |
| literal stock, 60 replicas | 1,244,515 | 1,244,515 | **1,243,415** |
| κ | 7.44714499357628e-4 | 7.44728650221677e-4 | **7.45287034630032e-4** |

Not applied: the 7 helpers with two later writes (dim 21 at the cut) and #280's 60 transported dirty entrances.

## Verify

```bash
python3 -m pip install -r research/five-stage-gen5-restore/requirements.txt
```
```bash
python3 -B research/five-stage-gen5-restore/verify.py --output /tmp/gen5-restore-verification
```

Python 3.11+, SymPy 1.14.0, a new output directory outside the package; no network; about 6 minutes. Prints `PASS_IMMUTABLE_GEN5_KERNEL_ENTRIES_FIVE_STAGE_BANKED_CONSTRUCTION` with the pinned κ.

## Scope and credits
